The bioToolkit ggplot2 theme

Source: R/theme.R
theme_bioToolkit.Rd

The theme shared by all plots of the package: 11 pt text (9 pt tick labels and legend text, 12 pt titles), 1 pt axis lines and 0.5 pt other lines. Three layouts are provided:

"axis"

Classic axes: axis lines and black ticks, no grid. For scatter, volcano, MA, bar and PCA plots.

"grid"

The axes of "axis", plus light grid lines, no axis titles and x labels rotated by 45 degrees. For dot plots and heatmaps, whose rows and columns are categories.

"embedding"

No axes at all, with extra room at the bottom left for the dimension arrows. For UMAP / tSNE plots.

Panel sizes are not part of the theme; add panel_size_theme to fix them.

Usage

theme_bioToolkit(
  type = c("axis", "grid", "embedding"),
  base.size = NULL,
  base.family = NULL,
  bg = "transparent"
)

Arguments

type

Layout of the theme, one of "axis" (default), "grid" or "embedding"

base.size

Base font size in points. If NULL (default), 11; otherwise the other text sizes are scaled with it

base.family

Font family. If NULL (default), the device default (Helvetica in PDF, which journals accept as Arial's equivalent)

bg

Background colour, default is "transparent" (NA also means transparent), so that figures can be placed on any background. Use e.g. "white" for an opaque background

Value

A ggplot2 theme

See also

panel_size_theme, save_plot, italic_labels

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
p + theme_bioToolkit()

p + theme_bioToolkit(base.size = 8)
